tracks.title: Zonal Climate Anomalies 1880-2023
tracks.summary: 144 years of warming in eight latitude zones, checked against the GISS CSV (r 0.9997). The proof track.

tracks.title: Change in Night Lights between 2012 and 2023 - EIC Version
tracks.summary: Night lights 2012 to 2023: the city hum grows and the birds and insects fade. Anthrophony vs biophony.

tracks.title: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature
tracks.summary: Ocean temperature, frame by frame, over a Pacific hydrophone; model-written strings and bass. Geophony.

tracks.title: Lightning Events Detected from the International Space Station (ISS) 2017-2023
tracks.summary: Six years of lightning seen from the ISS: drums where the storms are, thunder at every burst, a flute for the storm belt's latitude.

tracks.title: GEDI Forest Height
tracks.summary: Forest canopy height from the GEDI lidar as the globe turns; a forest chorus swells over the rainforests. Biophony.

tracks.title: GEOS Aerosols (2025)
tracks.summary: One snapshot of the world's aerosols swept west to east: one instrument per type (sea salt, dust, sulfate, smoke).

tracks.title: Florida Nighttime Lights Before and After Hurricane Ian
tracks.summary: Southwest Florida's lights before and after Hurricane Ian: the city hum fades and frogs and insects take over.

tracks.title: Sea Surface Temperature (SST) Anomaly - Near Real Time
tracks.summary: Daily sea surface temperature anomaly, 2024 to 2026, updated by NASA every day. Geophony.

tracks.title: Daily Arctic Sea Ice, By Year
tracks.summary: Daily Arctic sea ice, April 2021 to April 2023: two melt seasons and two freeze-ups. Geophony.
